name: Browserless
description: Browserless lets agents open pages in a hosted browser, read their content, take screenshots, and make PDFs, also on sites that need JavaScript. Each user signs in to their own Browserless account through the browser.

prompts.text: Open this page in a browser and give me its main text.
Take a full-page screenshot of our pricing page.
Make a PDF of this article.

apps.name: Browserless
apps.description: Hosted browser sessions, page content, screenshots, and PDFs, over Browserless' MCP server with browser sign-in.
